paragraphs: Fluxx sells grants management software for both sides of a grant, the funders who give money and the organizations that receive it. The grantmaking product is described as a cloud-based platform used by foundations and government agencies to manage the full grant lifecycle. The companion product is aimed at teams managing growing portfolios of active grants.

Grantmaker organizes work through role-based dashboards meant to give visibility and accountability across the process. Grantees get a personalized portal where they and funders coordinate applications, projects, outcomes, and financials in one place. Grantseeker centralizes grant data, deadlines, documents, and financials so teams work from the same information. An AI feature answers plain-language questions grounded in a customer's grants and program data. Grantelligence is the BI and analytics layer where teams create dashboards. The company says most organizations implement Grantseeker in roughly one to two weeks.

Fluxx says it has spent over 15 years working with private foundations, public agencies, and nonprofit institutions. The about page describes the company as women-led, values-driven, and a Pledge 1% member organization. It is backed by Metamorph Partners, a private equity firm focused on B2B SaaS, and ABS Capital. Published case studies include the Texas Veterans Commission cutting a review cycle from 45 days to 4 hours. The homepage puts annual funding across the platform at more than $39 billion.
